text: Seems very helpful, but I still forget to use the app, despite the reminders. So very adhd here lol. But it is not your generic adhd app like any selfhelp app with a adhd make up. And the discussions in the community arr deeper than I thought. So yeah 5 stars.
author: judith esvan (“judith E.”)
developer_reply: We appreciate your kind words and are glad to hear that you find our app helpful. We understand that it can be challenging to remember to use the app, especially with ADHD. We're constantly working on improvements to our reminders feature. Thank you for your support and for being part of our community! The Fabulous Member Care team.

text: Within a single week, I have already started feeling less anxious, and more confident in my ability to make things happen.
author: Delphine Mariotte
developer_reply: We're thrilled to hear that you're feeling less anxious and more confident! This is exactly what we hope to achieve with CLARIFY. We understand that this can be a challenging journey, and we're committed to supporting you every step of the way. The Fabulous Member Care team is here for you.
